propositions: dependabot PR #131 proposes bumping five packages (botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, ruff) but cannot merge via GitHub because main is gated through Gerrit.
The change must be re-authored as a Gerrit change, verified with both LLM-Review and Verified +1 votes, and merged to main for dependabot to auto-close the PR.
New versions of mypy 2.3.1 and ruff 0.16.3 may surface additional linting or type-checking findings that must be fixed in code rather than suppressed with comments.
The lock must be regenerated with the project's uv workflow rather than hand-edited, and all gates (make lint, make typecheck, complexity ratchet) must pass with zero new findings.
PR #131 must be verified as closed after the Gerrit merge lands and the mirror syncs; if dependabot does not auto-close it, manual closure with a comment naming the Gerrit change is required.
